model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, comparing three distinct scenarios: before gate, after gate, and after average gate. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 23 on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are depicted: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate, with an average value of 0.03, which starts at approximately 0.17 at layer 0 and decreases to around 0.01 at layer 23; an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after gate, with an average value of 0.44, which begins at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to about 0.13 at layer 12, and then fluctuates between 0.13 and 0.45 from layer 12 to 23; and a green dash-dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after average gate, with an average value of 0.33, which starts at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to around 0.1 at layer 12, and then remains relatively stable between 0.1 and 0.07 from layer 12 to 23.
model_annotations.Chinese: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at a threshold of 1e-2 across different layers, comparing three distinct scenarios. The x-axis represents the layer number, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 23, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, also on a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. Three lines are depicted: the blue dashed line represents the sparsity ratio before the gate, with an average value of 0.03, starting at approximately 0.17 at layer 0 and decreasing to around 0.01 by layer 23; the orange dotted line shows the sparsity ratio after the gate, averaging 0.44, beginning at 1.0 at layer 0, dropping to about 0.12 by layer 12, and then fluctuating between 0.1 and 0.4 from layer 12 to 23; the green dash-dotted line indicates the sparsity ratio after the average gate, with an average of 0.33, starting at 1.0 at layer 0, declining to roughly 0.1 by layer 12, and remaining relatively stable around 0.1 until layer 23.
